emailVerified.description: False until the address is confirmed (verify link, password reset or accepted staff invite). An unverified owner cannot invite staff or list the business in the directory (409 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED).

category.description: Business category key. New writes must use a listed key; legacy free text already stored is still returned unchanged.

area.description: Area key (Sidon, Beirut, ...). null clears it.

depositEnabled.description: Ask clients with past no-shows for a deposit to confirm a public booking (owner).

depositThreshold.description: Past no-shows a client needs before a deposit is asked.

depositAmount.description: Deposit in the business currency (USD placeholder).

listed.description: Opt in to the public directory. Turning it on needs a confirmed owner email (409 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED), a ready business (409 NOT_READY) and a category and an area (400 with fields.category / fields.area). A business that is already listed stays listed without an area.

category.description: A category key, or legacy free text.

invites.description: Pending (not accepted, not expired) invites, newest first.

futureAppointments.description: Upcoming active appointments of this business that remain on their calendar entry.

staffId.description: Present only when a specific staff member was requested.

h24.description: An email reminder 24 hours before the appointment is planned (booked at least 24 h ahead).

h2.description: An email reminder 2 hours before the appointment is planned (booked at least 2 h ahead).

email.description: Whether the client has an email address. When false no reminder email can be sent, so h24 and h2 are false too.

Reminders.description: The email reminders planned for this booking (a send can still be skipped, for example by the daily email budget), from the ReminderJob rows. Pages promise nothing else. All false for a deposit hold (none until paid), for a cancelled booking and for a client without an email address.

manage.description: Signed link, expires at the appointment start.

status.description: Only when a deposit is needed first: the slot is held (appointment.status PENDING_PAYMENT) until holdExpiresAt. No reminders or confirmation email until it is paid.

reminderEmail.description: Staff only. The address reminder emails for this booking go to (the booking address, else the client record address; null when neither is a plausible address). Never in a public response, link, email, log or export.

contactEmail.description: Staff only. The address typed for THIS booking (the override), or null when there is none and the client record address is used. Never in a public response, link, email, log or export.

contactName.description: Staff only. The name typed for THIS booking, or null when there is none and the client record name is used.

reminderEmailDiffers.description: True when reminderEmail is set and is not the client record's email.

holdsExpired.description: Lapsed deposit holds (PENDING_PAYMENT) cancelled and offered to the waitlist.

kind.description: H24 and H2 are the reminders. LATE is a public booking made less than 2 h before the slot: it is due at once, shown until the appointment starts, and its text is a booking confirmation.

count.description: All appointments waiting for an outcome (not capped by limit).

appointments.description: Appointments held or missed (attended + no-shows). Excludes cancellations and late cancels.

rateDefinition.description: Pilot rate definition to show next to the numbers.

baselineDefinition.description: What the baseline appointments field means.

appointments.description: Appointments held or missed (attended + no-shows). Excludes cancellations and late cancels.

noShowRate.description: Percent, 1 decimal: noShows / (attended + noShows). Null without marked outcomes.

changePoints.description: pilot rate minus baseline rate, percentage points.

changeRelativePct.description: Relative change; null when the baseline rate is 0.

confirmRate.description: Percent. Population: appointments that already started, not CANCELLED, LATE_CANCEL or PENDING_PAYMENT, that had at least one H24 or H2 reminder SENT (email or WhatsApp). confirmRate = the share of them with confirmedAt set. The booking email carries the confirm link too, so a confirmation may pre-date the reminder.

waitlistSlotsOffered.description: Freed slots offered to the waitlist: distinct freedFromAppointmentId of offers created in the pilot window.

waitlistRefills.description: Of those freed slots, the ones whose offer was CLAIMED (rebooked from the waitlist).

waitlistRefillRate.description: Percent: waitlistRefills / waitlistSlotsOffered. Null when nothing was offered.

refilledFromWaitlist.description: Refilled from the waitlist ON this local day (business timezone): replacement bookings whose claim happened on this day, for any appointment day. Cancelled replacements and unpaid deposit holds are not counted.

status.description: TAKEN: the slot went to someone else. UNAVAILABLE: the client left the waitlist (or staff removed the entry). ALREADY_BOOKED: this waitlist request already holds a booking from another offer. HOLD_LAPSED: the client claimed this offer, did not pay the deposit in time and the hold was released; the slot is not offered to them again, they stay on the waitlist.

staffId.description: The staff member the client asked for; null = anyone.

rejoin.description: What the "join the waitlist again" link pre-fills (service and staff of the waitlist request). Nothing about the client.

firstName.description: First word of the client name.

phone.description: Masked, always `•••• ••• ddd` (last 3 digits). The full number never leaves the server.

total.description: All OPEN entries, also when `limit` cuts the list.

price.description: The full price of the service (the board Total). Not the deposit.

address.description: The public address of the business, as on its booking page. Omitted when none.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: A user with several memberships is signed into the most recently created one. Attempts are counted before the password is checked: 5 per email+IP per 15 minutes, 20 per IP per 15 minutes (all emails) and 30 per email per hour (all IPs); a success refunds its hits. Over a limit -> 429 TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS with Retry-After. IPv6 addresses are limited per /64. Password checks are capped per server instance: 503 SERVICE_BUSY with Retry-After when saturated.

401.description: INVALID_CREDENTIALS (same body for wrong email and wrong password)

post.summary: Confirm an email address with the emailed token (public, single use)
post.description: The token comes from the link in the verification email (valid 24 hours). Unknown, expired, used and wrong-kind tokens are the same 410 LINK_INVALID. The page that shows the link only displays a button: opening the link never changes state, only this POST does.

410.description: LINK_INVALID (unknown, expired or already used; not distinguished)

post.summary: Send a new verification email to the signed-in user
post.description: Older unused links keep working until one succeeds (at most 5 live per user). Limited to 3 per hour per user and 10 per hour per IP (429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After). An already verified user gets 200 with alreadyVerified true and nothing is sent.

503.description: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE (the email could not be sent)

post.summary: Ask for a password-reset email (public)
post.description: ALWAYS answers the same 200 whether or not an account exists (no user enumeration); only the rate-limit count happens before the response, the lookup and the email run after it. Past 5 per hour per email address the answer is still the same 200 and nothing is sent (no per-email 429). 10 per hour per IP -> 429 RATE_LIMITED, identical for every email. The link is valid for 1 hour and works once; several links may coexist (at most 5 live) and using one deletes the others.

post.summary: Set a new password with the emailed token (public, single use)
post.description: Sets the new argon2 hash, marks the token used, marks the email verified and REVOKES ALL sessions of that user (it does not sign anyone in). Same password rules as signup (10 to 128 characters). Unknown, expired, used and wrong-kind tokens are the same 410 LINK_INVALID; a weak password is a 400 and does not use up the token.

410.description: LINK_INVALID (unknown, expired or already used; not distinguished)

post.summary: Change the signed-in user password
post.description: Verifies the current password (a wrong one is a 400 on currentPassword), sets the new hash and revokes all OTHER sessions of the user; the current session stays. Limited to 5 attempts per 15 minutes per user.

patch.summary: Record attended / no-show / late cancel (and correct it later)
patch.description: Only for appointments that have started (409 NOT_STARTED); ATTENDED additionally needs the appointment to have ended (409 NOT_ENDED), because leaving BOOKED/CONFIRMED re-opens the slot in the no-overlap constraint; NO_SHOW is allowed from 10 minutes after the start (409 NO_SHOW_TOO_EARLY, with data.availableAt = the ISO instant it opens), so a client who is a few minutes late does not lose the slot to a walk-in; LATE_CANCEL is allowed once it started. The grace applies only when moving into NO_SHOW from BOOKED or CONFIRMED: a correction from an outcome already recorded is never held back. Re-marking between outcomes moves one count between the client counters in the same transaction; the same outcome again is a no-op 200. CANCELLED appointments, and a LATE_CANCEL recorded by the cancel flow, cannot become attended or no-show (409 CONFLICT).

404.description: Not found (or belongs to another business)

409.description: NOT_STARTED, NO_SHOW_TOO_EARLY (data.availableAt), NOT_ENDED or CONFLICT

post.summary: Excuse a no-show or a late cancel (turns it into a normal cancellation)
post.description: For an appointment whose status is NO_SHOW or LATE_CANCEL (marked by staff or written by the cancel link). In one transaction, with the appointment row locked: the status becomes CANCELLED and the matching client counter (noShows or lateCancels) goes down by one, never below 0. cancelledAt / cancelledVia set by the cancel link are kept; otherwise cancelledVia is STAFF. No reason is accepted or stored. Idempotent: an appointment that is already CANCELLED answers 200 and changes nothing. 409 CONFLICT for BOOKED, CONFIRMED, ATTENDED and PENDING_PAYMENT. OWNER and STAFF. Does not touch appointment_no_overlap (none of these statuses is in its active set).
